summary: Rejected after independent review of all 39 claim and 33 active-hint changes against the staged source packet. The candidate correctly identifies that unanchored literary and historiographical references cannot supply imported Western personal chronology, but it overreaches by converting 15 pre-existing qualitative legendary-antiquity claims into unresolved research holds and replacing their qualitative hints. That changes valid source-supported classification rather than narrowly removing unsupported dates.
